title: Kept world state outside the chat model so inventory stops rewriting itself
author: Disastrous_Most_7963
selftext:
I spent months in AI dungeon / chat RP tools where the first hour feels great and turn ten the tavern rewrites itself. The sword vanishes. The NPC I bribed is a stranger again.

I got annoyed enough to try the boring path: rooms, inventory, and NPC notes live in a DB between turns. The model mostly narrates the next beat from a compressed context. Still messy. First token can take a few seconds. JSON from the orchestrator still breaks when I swap models. But at least the dagger stays in the bag.

Built it as a browser alpha (no install). About 200 free turns, 18+. RU product, English-friendly enough to poke around.

How I keep persistence cheap-ish:
- location skeleton + lazy room fill so I do not pre-generate the whole map
- inventory as real objects, not chat memory
- soft caps so the model cannot farm loot every "look around"

Happy to hear where immersion dies for you on tools that do external state vs pure chat. If pure amnesia is fine, ignore this.

Alpha if the sub allows a link: https://nevata.ru/news/alpha.html

Not selling anything. Mostly collecting notes from people who care more about maps and bags than preset character cards.
